entities.name: Bernadotte Dynasty & Union with Norway
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte (Charles XIV John) elected crown prince, the union with Norway (1814), Oscar II and the industrialisation of Sweden, the mass emigration to North America (over 1 million Swedes), and the peaceful dissolution of the Norwegian union (1905).
